title: Tabletop Cricket
author: storytime_yt
selftext:
I remember playing 'Test Match' a tabletop cricket game with my dad when I was younger. I'm about to do the same with my boys.

I was playing around with some agentic AI tools and thought... I wonder if it can one shot a mobile version that I can pass and play with my kids.

It did amazing. Give it a play here: [https://sossa-dok.itch.io/tabletop-cricket](https://sossa-dok.itch.io/tabletop-cricket)

It's got plenty of flaws, but I'm having a bunch of fun with my boys passing the mobile between each other and setting high scores.

I was using [enjoy.dev](http://enjoy.dev), but my free trial has ended. I'm open to suggestions over other similar tools because I really loved using it, but can't afford more than one AI subscription as a hobbyist
